author: Smith_Titan
body:
Hello, Avicus Network.


Well, On the day 19 of October I was permanently banned on the Avicus Network of making Void Log for the fourth time ( Fourth punishment ).

Well, First I was correctly banned, On that exact minute I did void log when I was going to die so I was correctly 100% banned by the moderator sir Dilpickel.

I did void log because I was making a bridge and the block  under me desapeared ( Block lag ), So I came really angry and I void logged. I know that´s not a valid excuse, I´m not trying excuse me, What I made was completely wrong and I learned the lesson.

I know what I made was wrong, I´m really sorry for making void log, I really apologize, I know that what I did was wrong and I learn that´s not tolerated on this fantastic server.
Please give me a second opportunity, I really apologize and I wouldn´t make it again, I love Avicus Community & Server.

Thanks for considering this appeal, Thanks for your time


Best Wishes.



Smith_Titan
